task_title: speclang new scaffolds no build.yaml so first save always pipeline-fails
task_criteria: Scaffold from bin/speclang new writes a build.yaml whose pipeline.on_converge generates code; clean-box repro at HEAD: appending a spec block within 90s produces a file under src/generated, converge log has no 'Pipeline failed' / 'Cascade NOT complete', validate exits 0, new completes under 2s

items.criterion: Scaffold from bin/speclang new writes a build.yaml whose pipeline.on_converge generates code; clean-box repro at HEAD: appending a spec block within 90s produces a file under src/generated, converge log has no 'Pipeline failed' / 'Cascade NOT complete', validate exits 0, new completes under 2s
items.detail: bin/speclang:1986-1996 writes build.yaml with pipeline.on_converge: [{name: generate, run: "node scripts/speclang.cjs generate"}]. Live clean-box repro at HEAD (ef301d5) in /tmp/df020-repro: `node bin/speclang new demo --no-git` completed in 0.04s (<2s) and printed '✓ Created build.yaml'; daemon started (`node scripts/speclang.cjs start --no-dashboard`), spec block appended to specs/main.spec.md, and ~57s later (<90s) daemon.log showed '[Pipeline] Loaded config from build.yaml' -> '[StageExecutor] Running command: node scripts/speclang.cjs generate' -> 'Pipeline succeeded!' with src/generated/main.spec-main.ts, main.spec-extra.ts, main.spec-extra2.ts written; `grep -c 'Pipeline failed\|Cascade NOT complete' daemon.log` = 0; `node scripts/speclang.cjs validate` exited 0. Test run: `TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp npx vitest run tests/cli/new-project-runnable.test.ts` exit 0, 'Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 10 passed (10)', including 'ships a build.yaml whose on_converge generates code (DF-SPECLANG-020)' which loads the emitted file through PipelineConfigManager and asserts stages[0].run === 'node scripts/speclang.cjs generate'. [resolution 0.07; build.yaml]

items.criterion: Reachability/seam: the build.yaml written by `speclang new` is the file the daemon's PipelineExecutor loads (default path build.yaml in project cwd) and its stage command is runnable in the scaffolded project without install or PATH
items.detail: src/pipeline/config.ts:31 defaults configPath to 'build.yaml'; src/pipeline/executor.ts:28 uses options.configPath (undefined) and src/daemon/daemon.ts:416 constructs `new PipelineExecutor({ verbose: true })` with no configPath, so the daemon loads exactly the project-root build.yaml the scaffold writes (bin/speclang:1995). Repro daemon.log line '[Pipeline] Loaded config from build.yaml' followed by the generate stage SUCCESS confirms the seam end-to-end; the stage runs through scripts/speclang.cjs, which resolved the generator CLI with no install and no global speclang (generate exit 0 in the repro).
